entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
My VeloBand Pulse is not working.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a fault. The band is completely broken. It won't sync with the app at all, no matter what I do.
I see. And you believe the unit is defective? Let me get your account details to look into this. Can I have your email address?
Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th.
That's the one. Lasted a whole month.

I understand your frustration. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you... Okay, I've confirmed it here. All our items are eligible for a return for a full refund within 90 days of delivery.
Yes, absolutely. Since you're only about 30 days in, you are well within that window. I can process a full return for you right now.
Fine. I guess that works. Whatever.

Excellent. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending an email to mark.s@email.com with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack it up and drop it off. Once we receive the band, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay. I'll watch for the email.
Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Hopefully the return process isn't also broken.
I'm confident it will be a smooth process. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
